name: St Mary and St John Fisher, Denton
shortName: St Mary and St John Fisher

boundary.description: From Audenshaw Road, by Groby Road (both sides in St Mary’s Denton parish) to the railway, then by a bee-line to Guide Lane (including Ravenwood Drive and Poplar Street but excluding Nelson Street and Ravenwood Drive), and by a beeline to the bridge where Shepley Road crosses the River Tame, and southwards along the diocesan boundary (River Tame) to the Manchester – Marple railway bridge, then by the Stockport – Tameside Metropolitan District Boundary to the Stockport – Denton railway, and by the railway and the M60 Motorway to Manchester Road (A57) to a point east of Wilton Paddock and by bee-lines behind Wilton Paddock and Wilton Court to the Manchester – Tameside Metropolitan District Boundary and by this boundary to the junction of Debdale Lane and Kings Road and along Kings Road and Audenshaw Road to it junction with Groby Road.
